Hon'Ble Shri Justice Ashish Shroti
 &
 Smt. Uma Kushwah, Advocate
 On The 14th Of March, 2026
 Misc. Appeal No. 4551 of 2024
 Rakesh Singh Gurjar And Another
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri R.S.Gurjar - Advocate for the appellants.
 Shri B.K.Tyagi - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.
 Order
The fine of Rs.30,000/- has been imposed upon the appellants under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
With the consent of learned counsel for the parties, the amount of fine of Rs.30,000/- is reduced to Rs.20,000/- each, which shall be deposited by the appellants within fifteen days from today.
Accordingly, the appeal stands disposed of in above terms.

(ASHISH SHROTI) (SMT. UMA KUSHWAH,
